newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: SOCCER-MEXICO SECURE VALUABLE POINT IN COSTA RICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MEXICO SECURE VALUABLE POINT IN COSTA RICA.

text.p: Mexico earned a valuable away point by holding Costa Rica to a 0-0 draw in a CONCACAF World Cup qualifier on Sunday.

Costa Rica had scored 10 goals in warm-up friendlies against Venezuela and Cameroon but found the Mexican defence a different propostion in an evenly-balanced game which saw both sides adopt a cautious approach.
The home team, playing their first match in the final stage of the CONCACAF qualifiers, looked more dangerous in the second half with substitute Jafet Soto causing problems.
"My team showed personality," said Mexico's Yugoslav coach Bora Milutinovic, whose team beat Canada 4-0 at home last week.
Mexican fans had feared an upset in the making after their team lost away to Honduras and Jamaica in the previous stage of the qualifying competition.
"We dominated for 60 or 70 minutes," said Horacio Cordero, Costa Rica's Argentine coach.
